meta.parties: De Silva Et Al. v. Rodrigue Et Al

rules.statement: A fidei commissum created by Balthazar de Zoysa in favor of Louisa and her two daughters, Josephina and Johanna, and their descendants is valid, and the rights of the plaintiffs cannot be affected by any adverse possession that began after March 1854.
rules.supporting_quote: 'The learned District Judge has rightly held that the deed (P5) created a valid fidei commissum in favour of Louisa and her two daughters and descendants, and if Balthazar was the owner of this-property when he gifted it in 1854, the rights of the plaintiffs cannot be affected' by any adverse possession, which began thereafter.
